kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أسحنكك (form XIV)
# أَسْحَنْكِكُ (ʔasḥankiku) /ʔas.ħan.ki.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# أَسْحَنْكِكَ (ʔasḥankika) /ʔas.ħan.ki.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# أَسْحَنْكِكْ (ʔasḥankik) /ʔas.ħan.kik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
